title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.7 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 19:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 354 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.00)

Looks pretty quiet right now. ☀️

Today’s solar images show a prominent dark coronal-hole region and several bright active regions, while the coronagraph view appears routine.

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
